北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京阴天，体感 13℃，微凉且干燥，记得多喝水哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is cloudy, feels 13℃, a bit cool and dry. Remember to stay hydrated!

慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阴天，气温舒适 24℃。享受这惬意的天气吧！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is cloudy, a comfortable 24℃. Enjoy the pleasant weather!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阴天，体感 23℃，湿度较高，保持好心情哦！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is cloudy, feels 23℃ with high humidity. Keep your spirits up!

广州.name: 广州

广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is cloudy, feels 25℃, a bit muggy. Stay cool and refreshed!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳多云，体感 25℃，湿度较高，出门注意防晒哦！

杭州.name: 杭州

武汉.name: 武汉

重庆.name: 重庆

重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy, feels 22℃. A comfortable day, keep your spirits up!

青岛.name: 青岛

大连.name: 大连
